name: gap_scan_report
prototype: struct { u32 field0; u16 field4; u8 pad; u8 rssi; u8 addr_type; u8 length; u8 address[6]; ... }

ownership.argument: App-facing scan record: 0x54 bytes (allocation in the same callback), list links at +0/+4, the dword from report+0 at +8, the u16 from report+4 at +0xC, RSSI at +0x10, a flag byte at +0x11, the length at +0x12, the address at +0x13 followed by the payload.

provenance.source: Report layout as the scan report callback 0xC710334 consumes it (R4 = report): a dword at +0 is copied to the app record +8, a u16 at +4 to app record +0xC, the signed byte at +7 (LDRSB) is the RSSI and goes to app record +0x10, the byte at +9 is the address type (compared with 4 before the record is built), the byte at +0xA is the data length and is copied to app record +0x12, and the 6 address bytes at +0xC are copied to app record +0x13.

notes: App-facing scan record: 0x54 bytes (allocation in the same callback), list links at +0/+4, the dword from report+0 at +8, the u16 from report+4 at +0xC, RSSI at +0x10, a flag byte at +0x11, the length at +0x12, the address at +0x13 followed by the payload.
